subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acme-retail.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks — next step: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Ryan / Jenna,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about Acme's roadmap for in-product assistants. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps: 

Recap of needs:
- Primary use: conversational assistant inside checkout and support flows (higher QPS during peak hours)
- Target throughput: ~20–50 requests/sec average, up to ~150 RPS bursts during promos
- Typical prompt size: 80–160 tokens (avg ~120 tokens)
- Latency SLO: 150–200ms p95 for assistant responses; lower for core checkout flows
- Data controls: VPC/private deployment preferred for PCI/regulatory reasons

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive + sizing worksheet) with our sales engineer to align on model variants, batching behavior, and benchmark plan. Proposed agenda (30–45m):
1) Confirm traffic profile & critical SLOs
2) Walk through dedicated sizing worksheet (throughput, token mix, KV cache needs)
3) Model recommendations + quantization/trade-offs
4) Timeline, procurement, and next milestones

I can do the following slots next week (all PST):
- Tue, Nov 23: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed, Nov 24: 09:00–09:45 or 13:00–13:45

If those don't work, feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/dedicated-sizing

I'll attach a short sizing worksheet you can fill with representative qps / token distributions ahead of the call. Also looping in our SE (Camila) so she can join the session.

Thanks — excited to dig in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Wed 24 Nov 09:00 PST works for us (Ryan + Jenna). I've CC'd procurement so they can be looped on any timelines/contract questions.

A couple of quick clarifications for the worksheet so Camila has context before the call:
- Our steady-state target is closer to 30 RPS for the assistant with 3–4 concurrent sessions per user; peak bursts roughly 120–150 RPS for short windows (~5–10 mins) during promotions.
- Average input tokens: ~100, output tokens ~90.
- Latency: we need p95 < 200ms for checkout-critical prompts, p95 < 500ms acceptable for non-critical assistant experiences.

Also: are you able to support a VPC/private deployment with customer-managed key (KMS) for this engagement? We can cover details on the call.

Thanks — looking forward.
Ryan
Head of AI, Acme Retail
